name: CLI A2A Presence
statement: A developer views registered agents in the A2A network with their trust levels and governance status, optionally filtering by channel participation or specific agent identity.
successCriteria: limen a2a-presence returns JSON with count and agents array
Each agent includes name, trustLevel, domains, capabilities, and createdAt fields
--channel filters to agents who have sent to that channel
All stdout is valid JSON, all errors go to stderr as JSON
failureCriteria: limen a2a-presence --agent-id 'inv@lid' crashes instead of returning JSON error
limen a2a-presence --channel 'inv@lid' crashes instead of returning JSON error
Any command outputs non-JSON to stdout
preconditions: limen init completed (~/.limen/ exists with master key and config)
